title: Elementary symmetric of a sum of matrices
exact_target: Give a general partition formula for the elementary symmetric functions of a sum of matrices.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3027 (OPG-23298). CC BY 4.0.

R. S. Costas-Santos, \emph{On the elementary symmetric functions of a sum of matrices}, Journal of Algebra, Number Theory: Advances and Applications 1 (2009), 99--112; arXiv:math/0612464v5, §§1 and 5. Section 5 explicitly discusses the requested general partition expression.
